answer:
FINAL ANSWER: **13,047 CHIP variants remain** — 13,047 sample-level variant rows retained across all 86 `data/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/` workbooks (57,258 rows in, 44,211 removed) after excluding only the rows whose `Zygosity` call is literally `"Reference"`; no-calls (blank Zygosity) are retained and no secondary 56-gene filter is applied.

**Arithmetic reconciliations (all exact):**
- By Zygosity of kept rows: Heterozygous 7,303 + Homozygous Variant 4,593 = 11,896 genotyped variants, + 1,151 retained no-calls = **13,047**. Removed: Reference 44,211. 44,211 + 13,047 = 57,258 ✓ (86 files, guard `raw_rows−2 == parsed_rows` passed on every file).
- By trio role of kept rows: Mother 4,548 + Father 3,930 + Child 2,696 + Patient/Proband 1,873 = 13,047 ✓ (from 29 / 28 / 19 / 10 files).
- Role↔trio reconciliation: workbook roles give Patient/Proband=10, Father=**28**, Mother=29, Child=19 vs trio file Patient 10 / Father 29 / Mother 29 / Child 19 — the single gap is trio ID **533 (Father, Carrier) which has no workbook and contributes 0 rows**.

**Per-file audit (`per_file_counts.csv`, 86 rows, outliers visible):** columns sample, role, sheet, sheet_title_variant_count, rows_before, rows_Reference, rows_Heterozygous, rows_Homozygous_Variant, rows_blank_no_call, rows_after_removing_reference. Column sums: 57,258 / 44,211 / 13,047, and the row identity `before − Reference = after` holds for all 86 files. Extremes: smallest 354-PM 651→108, 360-P 647→109, SRR5562184 665→114; largest 380-P 704→672, 381-PM 705→671, then SRR5571393 676→171 (median kept 139, mean 151.7).
Outlier rows: `380-P  Patient/Proband  704 | Ref 32 | Het 68 | Hom 65 | blank 539 | after 672` and `381-PM  Mother  705 | Ref 34 | Het 87 | Hom 46 | blank 538 | after 671`.

**Caveats (as agreed, disclosed not acted on):**
1. 1,077 of the 1,151 retained blank genotypes come from 380-P/381-PM (539/538); these are ungenotyped superset sites with no DP/GQ/VAF. Excluding all blanks gives **11,896**.
2. The other 74 blanks sit at just 3 sites (11:119275949, 12:109556171, 17:7676483) and do carry DP/GQ — genuine no-calls.
3. Trio ID 533 has no workbook → contributes zero rows.
4. Residual exact duplicates (Chr:Pos+Ref/Alt+Zygosity within a sample) are kept, not deduplicated: 99 pooled (9 among kept rows).
5. Sheet titles "(Variants 674)" match parsed row counts in only 7/86 files and were ignored.
6. Descriptive panel check: every row in every file has `In_CHIP == True` and `Filter == PASS`, so all 86 exports are CHIP-scoped; 12,102 kept rows carry a 56-panel symbol in `Gene Names`, 945 carry only legitimate neighbour/read-through labels (MMAB, SF3B2, MMACHC, "TET2,TET2-AS1"), and 54/56 panel symbols appear.

**Secondary reading (on record, not the answer):** unique cohort sites among kept rows = 694 by Chr:Pos, 699 by Chr:Pos+Ref/Alt.

**Sensitivity table (all conventions pre-computed in the same run):**
| convention | value |
|---|---|
| **HEADLINE — sample rows, drop `Reference` only (blanks kept, no panel re-filter)** | **13,047** |
| sample rows, drop `Reference` AND blank no-calls | 11,896 |
| sample rows, drop `Reference` + require 56-panel symbol | 12,102 |
| sample rows, drop `Reference` + blanks + require 56-panel symbol | 11,036 |
| unique cohort sites, drop `Reference` only (Chr:Pos) | 694 |
| unique cohort sites, drop `Reference` only (Chr:Pos+Ref/Alt) | 699 |

Executed via `analysis/count_chip_variants.py` (asserts the header-offset guard and per-file CHIP-scope; idempotent reruns give identical numbers), stdout captured in `final_run.log`, machine-readable totals in `final_summary.json`.
